evidence.title: LGL-BW INSPIRE address from ALKIS house coordinates: Einsteinallee 14, 77933 Lahr/Schwarzwald, native ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N
evidence.publisher: Landesamt für Geoinformation und Landentwicklung Baden-Württemberg (LGL-BW)
evidence.attribution: LGL-BW (2026) Datenlizenz Deutschland – Namensnennung – Version 2.0, www.lgl-bw.de
evidence.excerpt: The state's official INSPIRE address service returns a single address point, house number 14 on Einsteinallee in Lahr/Schwarzwald, in the service's native ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N coordinates.

metadata.rights_scope: The service capabilities (AccessConstraints) license the data under Datenlizenz Deutschland – Namensnennung – Version 2.0 and require the source note naming LGL-BW and the retrieval year; Fees state free use under an open-data licence. One address point and its address components are restated with that attribution. The licence page itself was not fetched, because govdata.de's robots.txt disallows all automated agents; its URL is cited as printed in the capabilities.
metadata.literal_pointer: /wfs:FeatureCollection/wfs:member/ad:Address[@gml:id='Address.DEBWhx01000s9CqQ']: ad:position/ad:GeographicPosition/ad:geometry/gml:Point (srsName http://www.opengis.net/def/crs/EPSG/0/25832) gml:pos; ad:specification (GeometrySpecificationValue/building); ad:method (GeometryMethodValue/byAdministrator); ad:default true; ad:locator/ad:AddressLocator/ad:designator designator '14' (LocatorDesignatorTypeValue/addressNumber); ad:component references AdminUnitName.08317065, PostalDescriptor.77933 and ThoroughfareName.0831706583002.
metadata.request_semantics: Read-only WFS 2.0 GetFeature with no SRSNAME, so the response uses the service DefaultCRS. The small query box is expressed in EPSG:4258 only to select features and does not alter the returned coordinates. Exactly one ad:Address was returned.
metadata.source_crs: EPSG:25832, ETRS89 / UTM zone 32N, axis order easting then northing in metres; it is the DefaultCRS advertised for ad:Address in the service capabilities.
metadata.native_precision: Three decimals in metres (millimetre serialization), retained as the transformation input; serialization precision is not positional accuracy.
metadata.transformation: pyproj 3.7.1 with PROJ 9.5.1: 'Inverse of UTM zone 32N + ETRS89 to WGS 84 (1)', the only candidate operation with allow_ballpark=False, operation accuracy 1 m, always_xy=True. The datum step is the published null transformation between ETRS89 and WGS 84.
metadata.rounding: Rounded once to seven decimal places (about 0.004 m displacement); no geocoding, snapping, offset or digitizing.
metadata.point_semantics: An official address position held in ALKIS house coordinates and published under INSPIRE. Its specification code is 'building' (the position aims at identifying the related building) and its method code is 'byAdministrator' (decided and recorded by the official body or the dataset custodian). It locates the addressed site. It is not a cadastral parcel, building footprint, phase boundary or current work extent.
metadata.identity_bridge: The joint venture's own pages (evidence eu43-lahr-qfox-open-site-address and eu43-lahr-badencloud-site-page) give Einsteinallee 14, 77933 Lahr as the address of Rechenzentrum Lahr, the construction site of the open-site days. The point is looked up by that exact address; it is not inferred from a park, locality or office address.

evidence.title: LGL-BW INSPIRE addresses across the Einsteinallee area: exactly one house number 14
evidence.publisher: Landesamt für Geoinformation und Landentwicklung Baden-Württemberg (LGL-BW)
evidence.attribution: LGL-BW (2026) Datenlizenz Deutschland – Namensnennung – Version 2.0, www.lgl-bw.de
evidence.excerpt: A wide query around the business park returns 78 addresses, 24 of them on Einsteinallee, and exactly one with house number 14: the selected point.

metadata.content_hash_scope: SHA-256 of exact content-decoded response bytes, not extracted text or rendered pages.
metadata.capture_method: credential-free Node fetch; no retry; content-decoded response bytes
metadata.rights_scope: As for eu43-lahr-lgl-address-point-native. Only counts and the selected feature's identifier are restated.
metadata.literal_pointer: All 78 wfs:member/ad:Address elements; filter on ad:component ThoroughfareName.0831706583002 (24 addresses) and designator '14' (one: Address.DEBWhx01000s9CqQ).
metadata.completeness_scope: 78 features returned against a COUNT limit of 5000, so the response is not truncated. The 24 Einsteinallee points span latitude 48.353238 to 48.36433 and longitude 7.805919 to 7.816992, at least about 360 m inside every edge of the query box. This bounded check makes a second house number 14 on the street unlikely; it is not a statewide proof.
metadata.server_quirk: The response reports numberReturned='0' and numberMatched='unknown'; an inline server comment explains the schema-validation workaround. Counts here come from parsing the members, not from that attribute.
metadata.other_designators_note: Three Einsteinallee addresses carry eight-digit designators (for example 22897264) that are not ordinary house numbers. They are not interpreted.

semantics.precision_scope: Baden-Württemberg's official address position for Einsteinallee 14, the exact site address that the operator's own pages give for the Lahr data centre. It locates the addressed campus, not a data hall, phase, parcel boundary, footprint or current work extent. Native millimetre-serialized UTM coordinates were transformed once and rounded to seven decimals.
semantics.horizontal_uncertainty_unknown_reason: The service publishes the position's placement intent (building) and method (by administrator) but no positional accuracy for individual points. The 1 m figure is the ETRS89 to WGS 84 operation's accuracy, not the point's accuracy.

remaining_review_gate: Independent source, identity, lifecycle/successor and full-geometry review, then separately pinned acceptance and full release validation. This proposal alone increments no count.
